scope: Manual qualitative review of eight constructed pairs; not a benchmark or human study.

assessments.review_note: Correctly abstains from describing a depicted change.
assessments.expected: No depicted object or property changes.
assessments.prediction: There is no meaningful visual change between the two images.

assessments.review_note: Identifies the new small yellow object and its position/direction.
assessments.expected: A small yellow ball is added on the right.
assessments.prediction: A small yellow circle appears to the right of the blue rectangle in the AFTER image, which is absent in the BEFORE image.

assessments.review_note: Identifies the object absent after the before-to-after comparison.
assessments.expected: The small yellow ball is removed from the right.
assessments.prediction: The yellow circle that was present to the right of the blue rectangle in the first image is absent in the second image.

assessments.review_note: Identifies blue-to-orange color change with correct image order.
assessments.expected: The large car-like object changes from blue to orange.
assessments.prediction: The blue rectangle in the first image is replaced by an orange rectangle in the second image.

assessments.expected: The green square moves from the left to the right.
assessments.prediction: The green square moves from the left side to the right side of the upper portion.

assessments.review_note: Identifies right-to-left movement after swapping the pair.
assessments.expected: The green square moves from the right to the left.
assessments.prediction: The green square moves from the right side to the left side of the upper beige area.

assessments.review_note: Misreads a one-character substitution as an extra character.
assessments.expected: The sign text changes from EXIT to EX1T.
assessments.prediction: The AFTER image shows the letter 'T' added to the right of the word 'EXIT' within the box.

assessments.review_note: Reports a background color change instead of suppressing global brightness variation.
assessments.expected: No semantic change; the whole scene is brighter.
assessments.prediction: The background color above the rectangle changes from light beige to white.
